coverageNotes: Tests storage.store availability by function context. Does not separately score complete upload implementation, return typing, byte-length calculation, or failure cleanup.

questions.question: Which statement identifies the unsupported operation in this mutation?

options.text: Constructing the Blob requires an action; the storage and database calls are available in mutations.
options.rationale: Blob construction and size access execute successfully in the mutation control. The unsupported method is storage.store.

options.text: Calling storage.store requires an action; Blob construction, database insertion, and storage.getUrl are available in mutations.
options.rationale: TypeScript rejects storage.store on StorageWriter, and the bypassed mutation throws at that call. The action store plus mutation metadata control succeeds.

options.text: Calling storage.getUrl requires an action; Blob construction, storage.store, and database insertion are available in mutations.
options.rationale: getUrl works in a mutation for an existing storage ID; it is not exclusive to actions.

options.text: Calling db.insert requires an action; Blob construction and both storage calls are available in mutations.
options.rationale: Mutation contexts have db.insert. An action has no direct db and delegates database writes through runMutation.
